system.effect:
Prerequisites: Minor Gift – Eternal Presence
Daily – Standard Action
Target: A creature within 5m of you
Effect: Roll an AC 2 Status Attack. On a miss, this Feature has no effect, but is not Expended. On a hit, the target loses 10 Hit Points for each Combat Stage it has. It then loses all Combat Stages not gained from Legendary Auras, and you regain 5 Hit Points for each Combat Stage lost in this way.
